name: Support Aldric/Kira C
_source: speak;Aldric;Kira. How long have you served the Guard?
speak;Kira;Six years. Since I was sixteen.
speak;Aldric;You were already a lieutenant when I was learning to ride.
speak;Kira;You've caught up quickly, Your Highness.
speak;Aldric;Aldric. Please. 'Your Highness' from you feels strange.
